title: The latest report
description: A story lesson about a newspaper report on actress Karen Marsh. Karen told reporters that she might retire, that she couldn't make up her mind, that she would have to ask her future husband, and that her future husband would not let her make another film. The lesson introduces the use of 'would' and 'would have to' in reported speech. The workbook drills reported-speech comprehension questions about the story and vocabulary fill-in; the grammar workbook rewrites sentences using 'said'/'told' with 'would', completes a dialogue with reported-speech words, and rewrites 'would have to' sentences in reported speech.
answer_note: The story is from the textbook. Workbook A (comprehension questions about the Karen Marsh report) has no printed key, so the answers are model answers (suggested); Workbook B (vocabulary fill-in) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-135-141.jpg p.217). Grammar I (rewrite with said/told and would), II (complete dialogue with reported-speech words), and III (rewrite with would have to) are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.571).

lesson.text: Listen to the tape and then answer the question that follows. 听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。

lesson.text: The latest report. 最新消息。The latest newspaper report about Karen Marsh says: 'Karen Marsh has just arrived at her London hotel. She told reporters that she might retire. She couldn't make up her mind. She said that she would have to ask her future husband. Her future husband, the actor Michael Jones, said that he would not let her make another film.' 最新关于卡伦·马什的报纸报道说：「卡伦·马什刚到她的伦敦旅馆。她告诉记者说她可能要退休。她拿不定主意。她说她不得不问问她的未婚夫。她的未婚夫，演员迈克尔·琼斯说，他决不会让她再拍别的电影。」
lesson.translation: 最新消息。最新关于卡伦·马什的报纸报道说：「卡伦·马什刚到她的伦敦旅馆。她告诉记者说她可能要退休。她拿不定主意。她说她不得不问问她的未婚夫。她的未婚夫，演员迈克尔·琼斯说，他决不会让她再拍别的电影。」

lesson.text: Question: 问题。Who told reporters that she might retire? 谁告诉记者说她可能要退休？
lesson.translation: 问题：谁告诉记者说她可能要退休？

items.title: would 在间接引语中的用法
items.text: 在间接引语中，will 变为 would：She said (that) she would retire. / She told reporters (that) she might retire.

items.title: would have to
items.text: 「不得不」在间接引语中用 would have to：She said that she would have to ask her future husband.

items.title: might 的用法
items.text: 「可能」在间接引语中可以用 might：She told reporters that she might retire.

practice.title: Practice A: Comprehension (Karen Marsh report)
practice.instruction: Look at the latest newspaper report about Karen Marsh at the bottom of Students' Book page 273 and answer these questions. 参见学生用书第 273 页的底部有关卡伦·马什的最新报道，然后回答以下问题。
practice.translation: 参见学生用书第 273 页的底部有关卡伦·马什的最新报道，然后回答以下问题。
practice.context: 4 comprehension questions about the Karen Marsh newspaper report, answered using reported speech.

questions.prompt: What did Karen Marsh tell reporters at her London hotel? (What did she actually say? What were her actual words?)
questions.answer: She told reporters that she might retire. Her actual words were: 'I might retire.'

questions.prompt: Did she say that she could, or couldn't make up her mind? (What did she actually say? What were her actual words?)
questions.answer: She said that she couldn't make up her mind. Her actual words were: 'I can't make up my mind.'

questions.prompt: Who did she say she would have to ask? (What did she actually say? What were her actual words?)
questions.answer: She said that she would have to ask her future husband. Her actual words were: 'I will have to ask my future husband.'

questions.prompt: Who did she say would not let her make another film? (What did she actually say? What were her actual words?)
questions.answer: She said that her future husband would not let her make another film. Her actual words were: 'He won't let me make another film.'

practice.title: Practice B: Vocabulary (choose the correct word)
practice.instruction: Choose and write in the correct words in these sentences. 选词填空。

questions.prompt: That actor has ______ twenty films in his life. (done / made)
questions.answer: made

questions.prompt: 'This is my third ______,' the woman said when we met. (man / husband)
questions.answer: husband

questions.prompt: Those people ______ abroad for their holidays every year. (go / leave)
questions.answer: go

questions.prompt: Two friends of ours are ______ married next September. (going / getting)
questions.answer: getting

questions.prompt: 'This is my last job,' he said. 'I'm 60 and I'm going to ______.' (retire / leave)
questions.answer: retire

questions.prompt: 'I must ______ you to my wife,' the man said to me. (tell / introduce)
questions.answer: introduce

grammar.title: Grammar I: Rewrite the sentences using 'said' or 'told'
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 said 或 told 改写以下句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 said 或 told 改写以下句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.571 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 8 sentence-rewrite items; item 1 (I'll be back before dark. (the thief) → The thief said (that) he would be back before dark.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: I'll be back before dark. (the thief)
questions.answer: The thief said (that) he would be back before dark.

questions.prompt: We won't go to town on Saturday. (the children, their parents)
questions.answer: The children told their parents (that) they wouldn't go to town on Saturday.

questions.prompt: I can swim very well. (he, his friends)
questions.answer: He told his friends (that) he could swim very well.

questions.prompt: My parents will be in London next week. (she, him)
questions.answer: She told him (that) her parents would be in London the following week.

questions.prompt: I can't hear very well because it is so noisy. (he, her)
questions.answer: He told her (that) he couldn't hear very well because it was so noisy.

questions.prompt: I'm going to travel round the world. (she, her friend)
questions.answer: She told her friend (that) she was going to travel round the world.

questions.prompt: I won't let you make another film. (the producer, the actress)
questions.answer: The producer told the actress (that) he wouldn't let her make another film.

questions.prompt: I might retire next year. (the actress, the reporters)
questions.answer: The actress told the reporters (that) she might retire the following year.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Complete the dialogue (reported speech words)
grammar.instruction: 完成以下对话，填入适当的词（间接引语中的 would / would have to / couldn't 等）。
grammar.translation: 完成以下对话，填入适当的词（间接引语中的 would / would have to / couldn't 等）。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.571 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 fill-in items in a dialogue about a woman's plans to retire and make a film.

questions.prompt: Reporter: Have you made up your mind about the new film? Actress: No, I haven't. (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she hadn't made up her mind about the new film.

questions.prompt: Reporter: What are you going to do? Actress: I might retire. (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she might retire.

questions.prompt: Reporter: Why? Actress: I can't make up my mind. (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she couldn't make up her mind.

questions.prompt: Reporter: What will you do? Actress: I will have to ask my future husband. (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she would have to ask her future husband.

questions.prompt: Reporter: What did he say? Actress: He won't let me make another film. (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that he wouldn't let her make another film.

questions.prompt: Reporter: Are you going to travel? Actress: I might travel to England. (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she might travel to England.

questions.prompt: Reporter: When? Actress: I will go in the spring. (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she would go in the spring.

questions.prompt: Reporter: Who is coming with you? Actress: My future husband will come. (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that her future husband would come.

questions.prompt: Reporter: What will you do there? Actress: I will visit my friends. (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she would visit her friends.

questions.prompt: Reporter: How long will you stay? Actress: I will stay for a month. (reported speech)
questions.answer: She said that she would stay for a month.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Rewrite the sentences using 'would have to'
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 would have to 改写以下句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 would have to 改写以下句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.571 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 8 sentence-rewrite items using 'would have to'; item 1 (I have to ask my wife. → He said that he would have to ask his wife.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: I have to ask my wife.
questions.answer: He said that he would have to ask his wife.

questions.prompt: You must be quiet during the examination.
questions.answer: The teacher said that we would have to be quiet during the examination.

questions.prompt: We have to pay for everything we buy.
questions.answer: She said that they would have to pay for everything they bought.

questions.prompt: I must see the doctor this week.
questions.answer: He said that he would have to see the doctor that week.

questions.prompt: You have to show your ticket before you get on the train.
questions.answer: The conductor said that I would have to show my ticket before I got on the train.

questions.prompt: We must leave now or we'll miss the bus.
questions.answer: They said that they would have to leave then or they would miss the bus.

questions.prompt: I have to work late this evening.
questions.answer: She said that she would have to work late that evening.

questions.prompt: You must stop smoking.
questions.answer: The doctor said that he would have to stop smoking.
